notas: Excellent deployment. Ignition just before igniters pull away. Droplet drifts W in color camera FOV but stays in FOV the entire time. Hot flame extinguishers without oscillations. Long cool flame burn with large vapor cloud. No evidence of cool flame extinction (droplet seems to disappear).

Good deployment on fiber. Only a little motion on the fiber. Short hot flame with no flame oscillations. Nice stable droplet behavior on fiber. Long cool flame burn with no large vapor cloud. No visible cool flame extinction (droplet disappears).

IPSUG did not switch to continuous mode. This means we will get almost no hot or cool flame data from the intensified camera. Burn almost identical to last test. Good deployment and ignition on fiber. No motion on fiber during test. Hot flame burns 5-10 sec before extinguishing with no oscillations. Long cool flame burn and large vapor cloud. No cool flame extinction evident - droplet burns to near completion.

IPSUG did not switch to continuous mode. This means we will not get any hot or cool flame images from the intensified camera. Burn almost identical to last test. Good deployment and ignition ob fiber. Very little droplet motion on fiber. 5-10 sec hot-flame burn with no oscilations. Long cool flame burn and large vapor cloud. Again no evidence of residual droplet after cool flame extinction.

IPSUG did not switch to continuous mode. This means there will not be any visable hot or cool flame imagers from the intensified camera. Burn almost identical to last test. Good deployment and ignition on fiber. Very little droplet motion on fiber. 5-10 sec hot flame burn with no oscillations before extinction. Long cool flame burn and large vapor cloud. No evidence of residual droplet indicating cool flame extinction.
Good fuel dispense. Good, clean fiber. Almost perfect ignition. No flame oscillations. Large vapor cloud forms during cool-flame burning. Cool flame extinction is not evident.

Ran dummy test point w/ only igniters and intensified camera eyeled normally. Good, clear fuel, no bubbles. Perfect deployment, slight drift to lower igniter. No ignition. Slow drift S after igniters withdraw. Keep test point for vaporization info. Downlink file renamed to: FLEX-1212-2017-03-27-14h11m09s-F086A01.ts

I see delay between deploy and ignition. Using a fiber. As didn't work first time. Trying to work around. Deployed droplet on fiber manually. Deleted F086A03. Good deployment and ignition on fiber. Short burn to radiative extinction. Cool flame burning and vapor cloud. No residual droplet on fiber after test. Did droplet burn to completion?

Moved igniters closer and increased time. Good deployment. Droplet moves to lower igniter, ignites, then drifts NW. Hot flame oscillates several times before extinguishing. Droplet leaves FOVs shortly after cool flame burning starts.

Using orignal igniter positions but higher power and longer time. Good deployment and ignition. Slow drift S after igniter witdraw. The droplet stayed in the FOV for most of the cool flame burn (6 see hot flame). It likely drifted out and recording ended before cool flame extinction ( ~40 dec in FOV). It looks like cool flame extinction at a small droplet diameter. Large vapor cloud.

Droplet drifted hit lower igniter and drifted NW after igniter withdraw. Droplet drifted at a moderate speed, but stayed in FOV thru hot-flame extinction and well into cool flame burn. ~6 see hot flame burn. Oscillations at extinction.

Overstretched and lost first droplet. Droplet drifted to lower igniter hit igniter and slowly drifted NW after igniter withdraw. Drift was very slow and the droplet likely stayed in the FOV for the entire burn. Excellent test, likely captured entire burning history.

Good, clear fuel - a little off-centered on fiber. Good deployment on the fiber. Good ignition right before igniters pulled away. 10 sec hot flame followed. Long cool flame burn with a large vapor cloud. Looks like there was no residual droplet on fiber.
Tried to stretch a little more. Better deployment, but still drifting N (much slower). Hit upper igniter and drifted S slowly. Left FOV before hot flame extinction.
Better stretch. AS is not running. NO IPSU data. Excellent deployment. Slow drift S after ignition. Stayed in color cam FOV the entire test, but would have been out of HiBMS.

Tried to get a better stretch. Perfect deployment and ignition. Slow drift S after ignition but likely stayed in FOV for entire test. 12 sec hot-flame burn, no flame oscillations. Large vapor cloud and likely small extinction diameter.

Tried to maximize stretch. Slow drift to lower igniter after deployment. Hit lower igniter moved to upper igniter hit it as igniters pulled away. Slow drift W then back to center. Droplet flame was bright, got dim blue then seemed to burn with a "half-flame" for a while. Flame became spherical drifted to center and burned to completion.
Completed FoMA ops to 1.25atm. Lost first droplet to lower needle. Perfect deployment and ignition. Droplet easily stays in FOVs for entire test. 10 sec hot flame burn. Large vapor cloud.

Droplet drifts to lower igniter after deployment, hits igniter and slowly drifts NW after igniters pull away. Hot flame burns for ~20 sec oscillating several times before extinguishing. Droplet stayed in FOV for most of the test. Smaller vapor cloud at end.

Got a little more stretch this time. Droplet drifted towards lower igniter after deployment, continued after igniters pulled away. Droplet drifted SE after ignition. Probably didn't stay in FOV for the entire test but captured more than ~75%.
Good deploymen on fiber. Minimal motion. Hot flame burned for ~10 sec and extinguished without oscillations. Long cool flame burn, no residual droplet and large vapor cloud.

First tests since software update to protect igniter. Good deployment onto the fiber. New ignition scheme worked perfectly. 8 sec igniter on time. Flame ignites in approximately 5 sec. Igniters immediately de-energize and pull away. Hot flame oscillations then extinguishes after 12 sec. 7 sec ater entinction hot flame re-ignites followed by another re-ignition then cool flame burning.

Good deployment. Droplet starts ti drift to lower igniter hits  it and ignites. Slow drift S after igniters pull away. Hot flame oscillates before extinction. Droplet likely in FOV for a time after hot flame extinctin. Hot-flame re-ignites (around edge of HiBMS FOV likely). Droplet hits something (igniter?) then drifts back in FOV burning with hot flame.

Droplet driftsed to lower igniter after deployment. Hit igniter, then drifted slowly NW. Unclear whether it stayed in HiBMS FOV or not. Hot flame radiatively extinguished, then burned with a cool flame. Re-ignition of hot flame followed by hot flame burning to completion.
Droplet drifted to lower igniter, ignited and drifted slowly S. Hot flame oscillations, extinction and re-ignition.

Good run - all worked. Fiber supported. Ignited. No hot-flame oscillations. Several re-ignitions (3) - first took a longtime to reignite. After the first hot-flame extinction vapor cloud seems to form - but the re-ignition seems to clear it. Vapor cloud forms subsequently.

Good run - all worked. Fiber (check). Ignition. Flame oscillation and extinction. Re-ignition. Vapor cloud [formation?]. After quite sometime re-ignition. Vapor cloud goes away. Vapor cloud forms again.
Good run - all worked. Fiber. Flame oscillation. Extinction. Re-ignition. Vapor cloud [formation?].

Good development on fiber. Ignition occurs in about 6 sec. Very sooty hot flame burns for approximately 13 sec. Intensified camera did not switch to cool flame mode until end of burn. Droplet burns to completion with no re-ignition or vapor cloud. Hot flaem oscillated before extinguishing.
Still a lot of droplet motion on needles. Perfect deploymen. No motion during ignition. Igniters burned out. Saving for vaporization info.

First test with new software. Hot-flames mode on intensified camera for whole test. Excellent hot flame burn. Large dim blue, spherical flame. 12 sec hot-flame burn. Long cool flame burn. Residual droplet on fiber, but hard to see because of vapor cloud. Extinctio droplet diameter seems smaller than expected.

Fuel started bubbling. Camera in nominal Hot-cool operating mode. Bubbling seemed to get better. Hot flame ignited burned for several seconds and ignited residual droplet from last test. Brief envelope flame around both droplets then small droplet disrupted and left a spherical hot flame. Hot flame extinguished, larged vapor cloud and cool flame extinction. Residual droplet very cloudy. Vaporized droplet off fiber at 5W - mini-cool flame?

Using residual droplet from last test. Very long ignition time, but went directly to hot flame. Did not go to cool flames. Good fiber supported test. Long hot-flame burn. Long cool flame burn and large vapor cloud.

Free-floated test. Perfect deployment. Good ignition. Droplet stayed in FOV for the entire test. Nice spherical hot flame, no pre-extinction, flame oscillations. Long cool flame burn and huge vapor cloud.

Getting some large bubbles. Excellent deployment and ignition. Long hot flame burn, no pre-extinction. Flame oscillations. Long cool flame burn and large vapor cloud. Droplet stayed in FOV for the entire test.

Lost first droplet to lower needle. Drifted to lower ignite (SE1 after deployment). Droplet hit igniter, ignited drifted quickly NW and out of FOV. Droplet left FOV before hot flame extinction. Hot flame oscillated before extinguishing.

Some fuel bubbling due to FOMA OPs. Interior lights on and using an older version of software. No impact to science, but images on IPSUG data might be over-exposed. Based on experience camera may be in pulsed moded for duration. Excellent ignition. Large hot flame becomes dim blue. Hot flame burns for ~30 s after ignition. Vapor cloud started forming before cool flame extinguished.

Repeat last test since intensified camera may have been in pulsed mode for entire test. Results almost identical to last test. Flame ignites in 6 sec. Hot flame burns for ~12 sec w/ dim blue flame - no oscillations before extinction. Vapor cloud started to form ~30 sec after ignition. Long cool flame burn and large vapor cloud. Vapor cloud likely started to form before cool flame extinction.

Attempting DTC ignition w/ slightly lower energy than last time. Ignition threshold - 8.0 VDC Cool Flame Threshold - 6 VDC. Bubbling during fuel dispense. Igniters on for a long time ~13 sec. Ignited directly to hot flame. Hot flame burned for ~12 sec. Vapor cloud started to form ~30 sec after igniton. Burn almost identical to previous tests.

Moving to free-float tests. Some fuel [jitter?] on needles. Slight drift S after deployment, but droplet stopped just S of igniters. Droplet ignited and had very slow drift SE. Droplet likely remained in FOV for entire test. Droplet ignited in 8 sec w/ [luminous?] hot flame becoming dim blue. Hot flame burned for 12 sec, vapor cloud at 30 sec. Large vapor cloud.

Free-floated. Droplet drifts E-SE after deployment and ignition. Drift is slow, to lower igniter. Ignites in ~7 sec after hitting igniter. Continues to drift E slowly. Hot flame burned for ~10 sec. Droplet likely left FOV ~25 sec after ignition.

Some small bubbles that diappeared during dispense. Lost first droplet to lower needle. Droplet drifted to lower igniter, hit igniter and drifted SE and out of FOV close to when hot flame extinguished. Flame oscillations before extinction.

Increased burn-to-completion time to 63 s. Good deployment. Small puff on upper igniter, but OK. Droplet drifted to upper igniter, but ignited and stayed in place (fiber). Good hot-flame burn, bright yellow becoming dim blue, extinction 12 sec after igniter withdraw. Vapor cloud forms ~30 sec after igniter withdraw.

Trying DTC ignition w/ slightly lower igniter power. Using same thresholds as FLEX-1244 (F123A03). Droplet drifted to upper igniter immediately after deployment. Droplet very close to igniter. Ignited hot flame after ~11 sec. Same hot-flame behavior as previous test. Hot flame luminous yellow turns dim blue burns for 10 sec. Vapor cloud formation after 30 sec (igniter wdw).

No fuel bubbling. Perfect deployment and ignition. Almost no drift. Droplet stays in FOW for entire test with almost no drift. Typical hot-flame burn with luminous yellow flame turns quickly dim blue and extinguishes after ~12 sec. Long cool-flame burn. Vapor cloud forms ~30 sec after igniter withdraw.

Maybe under-stretched? Slow drift E towards upper igniter. Droplet hit igniter and continued slow drift E. Likely stayed in HiBMS FOV for ~20 sec after igniter withdraw. Flame oscillations before hot-flame extinction. hot flame burned for ~12 sec. Long cool.

Moved upper igniter away (500 cts). Droplet drifted to lower igniter, hit igniter and continued drift S-Se. The droplet likely moved out of the HiBMS FOV before hot-flame extinction and left color camera FOV when hot flame extinguished.

Trying DTC ignition again. Deploy droplet on fiber first, then run AS. Droplet dituated prefectly between igniters. Igniters on for 15 sec before getting hot flame ignition. Good hot-flame ignition and burn. Hot flame burned for ~10 sec. Long cool flame burn and large vapor cloud.

No bubbling in initial fuel dispense. Good deployment on fiber. Good hot-flame ignition. Luminous yellow flame becomes dim blue oscillates and then extinguishes. Long cool flame burn, no residual droplet on fiber. No vapor cloud or re-ignition. Camera settings didn't change as set.

Using residual droplet from last last size is ~3.8 mm. Ignition to hot flame at t > 10 sec. Luminous hot flame turns dim blue, oscillates then extinguishes. Long cool flame burn with no residual droplet and no vapor cloud.

Repeating F130A01 with correct camera settings. Nominal test HTC ignition. Good hot flame ignition. Luminous yellow flame becomes dim blue, oscillates and extinguishes. Cool flame burning w/ slight image present on color camera. Faint image disappears and cool flame starts to pulse. No re-ignition.

Still no fuel bubbling. Excellent deployment. Droplet motionless on ignition. Begins a slow drift N after igniters move away. Luminous flame turns dim blue oscillates and extinguishes. Short cool flame burn, re-ignition of hot flame. Re-ignited hot flame oscillates then becomes steady spherical flame that burns to completion. Drifts out of FOV before burn complete. Fuel start 154041 Now 136872.

No bubbling. Good deployment onto the fiber. Long ignition time, but did ignite (~12 sec). Luminous hot flame becomes dim blue turns dim blue, burns for ~12 sec before oscillating and extinguishing. Brief hot flame ~15 sec after ignition. First re-ignition ~20 sec after ignition. Two more re-ignitions at ~5 sec intervals. Longer period before more re-ignitions.

First test at 5 atm. Minimal fuel bubbling. Some axial motion on fiber. Very long ignition time ~11 sec. No IPSU-G data to check radiometer values. Small luminous yellow flame initially. Some disruptions on fiber for first few seconds of hot-flame burn. Flame becomes dim blue 7 sec after ignition. Flame is not really spherical. Oscillates for ~5 sec. Flame extinguishes, but some faint image on color camera. No vapor cloud.

Clear fuel and good deployment on fiber. Small disruptions after long ignition time. Luminous flame became dim blue after 8 sec. Flame exhibited large oscillations for a few seconds before extinguishing. After hot flame extinguishes there is a faint image in the color camera and some dim glow of the carbide fiber. Smooth burnout of fuel droplet. Dim glow on fiber gets brighter as droplet gets smaller.

Very sooty flame initially located very close to the droplet. Lots of disruptions initially, then flame becomes dim blue. Droplet burns w/ hemisperical flame for a short time before extinguishing. Some flame oscillations and then cool flame burning. Very dim oscillating flame visible on color camera. Flame gets a little brighter before burning out.

Increased recording time to ~80 sec. lots of motion on the fiber after deployment and during ignition. Luminous yellow flame with a lot of disruptions right after igniters pull away. Flame becomes dim blue and oscillates a few times before extinguishing. Cool flame burning w/ faint flame present on color camera. Hot flame re-ignited twice, and extinguished. Filter wheel may not hav moved to CF mode.

Good deployment on fiber with almost no residual motion. Good ignition in ~5 sec. Luminous flame initially quickly after ~7 sec burn time. Vapor cloud starts to appear ~20 sec after ignition. Long cool flame burn w/ no residual droplet on fiber.

A few bubbles during dispense. Good stretch. Perfect deployment, no residual motion. No ignition-imparted motion. Droplet remained in FOVs for entire burn. Droplet ignites in ~5 sec. Hot flame very luminous initially, burns for ~8 sec. Hot flame becomes dim blue quickly and extinguishes quickly. Long cool flame burn, no residual droplet.

Some small bubbles during dispense. Good stretch. Slow drift to lower igniter, droplet hit igniter and drifted quickly NW when igniters pulled away. Droplet drifts out of FOV about when hot flame extinguishes. Hot flame burned for ~8 sec and oscillated several times before extinction. Droplet well out of FOV during cool flame burning.

Moving back to fiber. Good deployment on fiber with no residual motion. Droplet ignites ~5 sec after deployment. Lumious hot flame becomes dim blue quickly. Hot flame burns for ~7 sec and extinguishes suddenly. Vapor cloud starts to form ~20 sec after ignition. Long cool flame burn and no residual droplet on fiber.

Skipped F146AQ1 because of common issues. Slight shift to lower igniter on fiber after deployment. Good ignition w/ luminous flame. Soot luminosity disappears in ~4 sec. Hot-flame extinguishes in ~8 sec. Not much motion of droplet on fiber. Faint image present on camera with very dim glow from fiber. Glow disappears 17 sec after ignition. Re-ignition after glow disappears. Oscillating flame extinguishes and re-ignites.

Attempt to free float, lost first droplet to lower needle. Excellent deploymen, slow drift to upper igniter as igniters heat. Ignition in ~6 sec. Luminous hot flame becomes dim blue, oscillates and extinguishes in ~9 sec. Faint oscillating, very dim flame present on color camera. Hot flame re-ignites 16 sec after hot flame extinction. Stays in FOVs beyond re-ignition.

Re-using droplet from last test. Hot flame ignites in ~10 sec. Hot flame brns with luminous flame that becomes dim blue, oscillates and extinguishes in ~7 sec. Faint flame present on color camera. Faint flame burns for ~11 sec before re-igniting to hot flame. Several re-ignitions and oscillations. No vapor cloud.

Burning a large droplet. Hot flame ignites in ~8 sec. Not much motion on fiber. Luminous hot flame becomes dim blue. Hot flame oscillates and extinguishes in ~7 sec. Faint flame (~standoff of hot flame) present and appears to oscillate. Faint flame disappears after 11 sec and hot flame re-ignites. Hot flame burning and oscillation, extincion and several re-ignition, extinction cycles.

Good deployment on fiber, no axial motion. Droplet ignites in ~8 sec. Luminous yellow flame gets dimmer, disappears in ~5 sec. Dim blue flame gradually disappears in ~9 sec. Stable faint image and glow on fiber after hot flame extinguishes. Faint flame gets dimmer and hot flame re-ignites ~26 sec after ignition. Hot flame extinguishes and re-ignites at ~37 sec.

Good deployment on fiber w/ almost no axial motion. Ignition w/ luminous yellow flame in ~8 sec. Flame glows, yellow disappears in ~6 sec. Hot flame gradually extinguishes in ~10 sec. Dim blue (very) and faint glow present on color camera. Dim flame disappears then flame re-ignites in ~28 sec. Hot flame extinguishes and dim flame returns.
